slides.main:
They sold records
to keep a club alive.
slides.sub: New Order and the Haçienda — 15 years of debt.
FAC 01. A label with no contracts — just handshakes.

text: New Order put in the money.
Drinks cheaper than the pub next door.
Blue Monday was made to pay the bills.
slides.sub: Every copy sold. Every pound went to the Haçienda.

text: DJ Mike Pickering spun house music.
Chicago and Detroit met a Manchester factory floor.
slides.sub: NUDE nights. The first house music club night in the UK.

slides.cta: Save this. Some things don't need walls to survive.
